headline: Meta Shares Fall as Rising AI Spending Rattles Investors
summary: Meta Platforms' cost to insure its debt against default hit an all-time high amid investor concern over rising AI spending and plans to issue new shares.
why: Meta Platforms is a major global tech giant whose financial health and spending strategies heavily influence sentiment across the technology sector and broader stock markets.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Rising AI spending and debt insurance costs weighed on investor sentiment.

why_moved: Investors reacted negatively to surging artificial intelligence costs and plans for new share issuance, driving up default insurance costs and pushing shares lower.
